records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Works set up
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for setting up North Works on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for the note -- glad it's going well so far, and no rush on my end.

One thing that tends to make the difference early: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project in place is usually where it clicks. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to work through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
